columns.name: EVAL_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Primary key for section items

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: EVALUATION_ID
columns.description: Primary key of Evaluation.

columns.name: EVAL_SECTION_ID
columns.description: The identifier for the section (not shown in the UI)

columns.name: REFERENCE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the reference to the current item in Profile Management or Goal Management, depending on the type of the section item.

columns.name: PARENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This field indicates the parent item.

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Translated name for item.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the item.

columns.name: MEASUREMENT
columns.description: Usually used for objectives, this field indicates how achievement of an objective will be measured

columns.name: TARGET_PROF_REV_RATING_ID
columns.description: This is the target performance rating for the item.

columns.name: TARGET_PERF_REV_RATING_ID
columns.description: This is the target proficiency rating for the item.

columns.name: PERF_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: This is the rating model for performance for the item.

columns.name: PROF_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: This is the rating model for proficiency for each item

columns.name: TARGET_DATE
columns.description: This is the target date of the item.  Typically applied to objectives

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This the start date of the item.  Typically applied to objectives

columns.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DATE
columns.description: This is the achievement date of the item.  Typically applied to objectives

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: This is the due date for the item.

columns.name: REMINDER_DATE
columns.description: This is the reminder date for the item.

columns.name: MIN_WEIGHT
columns.description: This is the minimum weight of the item.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.description: This is the weight of the item.

columns.name: OWNED_BY
columns.description: This field indicates the ownership and responsibility for a particular item.

columns.name: RATING_OVERIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates wheter to overide the ratings

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates if an item is mandatory.  Such items cannot be deleted or modified by the user

columns.name: CRITICAL_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates if an item is critical.  This flag is maintained by the user

columns.name: PERCENT_COMPLETED
columns.description: Percentage of item completed

columns.name: ADDED_IN_TASK
columns.description: Indicates the Item is added during which task

columns.name: NOT_RATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the item is not rated.

columns.name: NOT_RATED_FLAG_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the person Id who updated the not rated flag.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
